item.title: Australia politics live: One Nation proposes superannuation changes
item.description:
One Nation has proposed a plan allowing renters and mortgage holders to access up to a quarter of their superannuation early. This measure aims to provide a cash boost for three years at the expense of retirement savings.

item.title: AfD wins German state election as Musk support noted
item.description:
The far-right AfD achieved a historic victory in Saxony-Anhalt, potentially becoming the first such party to gain state power since WWII. The party's lead candidate thanked Elon Musk for his support, while French officials expressed concern over the election outcome.
